description: List this WhatsApp Business account's quick replies (respostas rápidas): shortcut, message text, keywords and usage count. Read-only — nothing is changed on WhatsApp. Pass refresh=true to re-read them from WhatsApp first (slower); otherwise returns the last synced copy. Returns { quick_replies: [{ id, shortcut, message, keywords, count }], synced_at, source }. Only on QR connections.
name: whatsapp_quick_replies
